name: Sweet Summer Job
source:
You’re a young man starting fresh in a sun-soaked coastal city, landing a job at your uncle’s successful company. He’s offering more than just a career — you’ll be living in his spacious home, sharing the space with your alluring aunt and your sharp, fit cousin.

By day, you're pretending to work. By night, you're exploring the city’s beaches, nightlife, and discovering the hidden desires of those around you.

[From [url=https://www.snarkmultimedia.com/hentai-game/sweet-summer-job]the official website[/url]]
